scope: All 50 lower-stage leaves at the 163-edge rules7 baseline were reviewed. Nine ordinary source-backed routes are now integrated into the route data, with 41 leaves still classified. Core and generated/runtime artifacts remain the responsibility of their owners.

source.method: Read-only git object extraction and standard-library JSON/graph analysis; no upstream execution, checkout, asset download, or GUI.

semantics: All route assertions concern the selected pinned fan-game database, not official franchise canon or exact World DS requirements.
An empty source forward list is an evidence limit, not proof of biological or canonical terminal status.
Existing163 routes, stable IDs, profile stats, skills and art remain unchanged by this proposal.
Ordinary gates use current target profiles: Champion5/20, Ultimate10/50, Mega15/80 (level/bond). Raw upstream levels are recorded but not copied into the level20 prototype.
No Armor, fusion, same-stage mode conversion, variant collapse, or requirement substitution is proposed.
